question: In the scope of the calls HORIZON-CL3-2021-BM-01/02/03, it is stated that proposals are expected to engage with the Agency FRONTEX in the development of the project. Does this mean that FRONTEX must be a partner within the project consortium?
esST_answer:
As indicated in the work programme, and along the lines of the collaboration between the Commission and FRONTEX on border security research outlined in the published Terms of Reference, there is no need for FRONTEX (the Agency) to be a partner of a consortium or to be in the advisory board (or similar) of a project. Furthermore, applicants should expect that, if proposals will be successful and be granted funding, FRONTEX will be interested in observing and be kept updated on the progress of the project.

We advise you to read the documents available at the following links to better understand how to fulfil the requirements of “addressing the priorities of the EBCG and its Agency from the design of the project” for topics BM-01, BM-02, BM-03.

  • Frontex Regulation
  • Technical and Operational strategy for EU IBM
  • Frontex releases Risk Analysis for 2021
  • Sea Border Surveillance report 2019
  • Other FRONTEX publications
  • The ToR Frontex-Home

For more information on this topic, you can watch the video of the session dedicated to the cooperation with FRONTEX on the webpage of the InfoDay of Cluster 3 (01/07/2021).
